note: Every roadmap step carries its sources. Times are the guides' estimates.

steps.text: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission.
After Down to Earth, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house — the one possibly missable step in the whole game.
Meet Cal in Feng Shui and start his fishing quests.
Start Kenton's treasure diving with Island Dreams.
Scan vehicles and study animals from the start — discovery counts toward 100%.
Make a manual save at the end of Chapter 1.

stages.title: Stage 1 — Chapter 1, don't miss the meditation

steps.text: Play the story through Chapters 2–5; all 12 story trophies unlock automatically.
Do optional missions as they appear — Andy (Chapter 3, Lucia-only), Billy (after Coffee Break), Randy (after Clonin' Keys), Tyrone (after Here, Kitty Kitty), Bret (after Coffee Break, Jason-only).
Unlock the Key Cloner (Chapter 3, Clonin' Keys), the Dye Pack Jammer and Payday Loan robberies (Chapter 3, Credit Check).
Open bank vaults with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….
Buy garages through the Real Estate app (Chapter 2, Daily Driver) and register vehicles with Scooter Bros (Chapter 2, Moses).
Keep a manual save at every chapter boundary — there is no mission replay.
Work the checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Robberies first: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans, 8 vaults, and the fencing totals.
Then collectibles and activities: card sets, WAiNK, underwater, meditations, flamingos, ranges, drones, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 target decks.
Then discovery: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons.
Remember: only robberies, underwater, ranges, drones and Bret's quests need everything.
Finish the 8 qualifying stranger strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed; the rest are still being mapped.
Complete the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
Finish the remaining meditations, including the Ascent at the Mount Kalaga summit.
Do the Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 when it appears — one checklist warns it may count for Strangers & Freaks.
Sweep up the remaining one-off trophies: the hidden methods and the crime and money trophies.
Check the count trackers — every collectible total is listed in the Tracker.
Earn Vice Got a Price! — the platinum pops with the 54th other trophy.
